#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create a team meeting calendar event for next Wednesday at 3 PM (1 hour)."""

import datetime
import sys
import uuid

OUTPUT = "team_meeting.ics"
TITLE = "Team Meeting"
HOUR = 15  # 3 PM
DURATION = datetime.timedelta(hours=1)

# --- Determine next Wednesday (strictly after today) ---
today = datetime.date.today()
days_ahead = (2 - today.weekday()) % 7  # Wednesday == weekday 2
if days_ahead == 0:
    days_ahead = 7  # today is Wednesday -> next week's Wednesday
next_wed = today + datetime.timedelta(days=days_ahead)

# --- Determine local timezone ---
try:
    from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
    import time as _time
    tz_name = _time.tzname[0]
    # Map common abbreviated names to IANA names
    abbr_map = {
        "EST": "America/New_York",
        "EDT": "America/New_York",
        "CST": "America/Chicago",
        "CDT": "America/Chicago",
        "MST": "America/Denver",
        "MDT": "America/Denver",
        "PST": "America/Los_Angeles",
        "PDT": "America/Los_Angeles",
        "GMT": "UTC",
        "UTC": "UTC",
    }
    tz_name = abbr_map.get(tz_name, tz_name)
    tzinfo = ZoneInfo(tz_name)
except Exception:
    tzinfo = datetime.timezone.utc
    tz_name = "UTC"

start_naive = datetime.datetime.combine(next_wed, datetime.time(HOUR, 0, 0))
start = start_naive.replace(tzinfo=tzinfo)
end = start + DURATION
now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@team-calendar"

# --- Build ICS ---
try:
    from icalendar import Calendar, Event, Alarm

    cal = Calendar()
    cal.add("prodid", "-//Team Calendar//Calendar Skill//EN")
    cal.add("version", "2.0")
    cal.add("calscale", "GREGORIAN")

    event = Event()
    event.add("summary", TITLE)
    event.add("description", "Weekly team sync meeting")
    event.add("dtstart", start)
    event.add("dtend", end)
    event.add("dtstamp", now)
    event.add("uid", uid)
    event.add("status", "CONFIRMED")
    event.add("sequence", 0)

    alarm = Alarm()
    alarm.add("action", "DISPLAY")
    alarm.add("description", "Team meeting starts in 15 minutes")
    alarm.add("trigger", datetime.timedelta(minutes=-15))
    event.add_component(alarm)

    cal.add_component(event)
    ics_bytes = cal.to_ical()
except ImportError:
    def fold_line(line):
        # Fold lines longer than 75 octets per RFC 5545
        if len(line.encode()) <= 75:
            return line
        out = []
        current = line
        while len(current.encode()) > 75:
            cut = 75
            while cut > 0 and (current[:cut].encode())[-1:] == b"=":
                cut -= 1
            out.append(current[:cut])
            current = " " + current[cut:]
        out.append(current)
        return "\r\n".join(out)

    def fmt_dt(dt):
        return dt.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S") + ("Z" if dt.tzinfo == datetime.timezone.utc else "")

    lines = [
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
        "VERSION:2.0",
        "PRODID:-//Team Calendar//Calendar Skill//EN",
        "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
        "BEGIN:VEVENT",
        f"UID:{uid}",
        f"DTSTAMP:{now.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}",
        f"DTSTART;TZID={tz_name}:{fmt_dt(start)}" if tzinfo != datetime.timezone.utc else f"DTSTART:{fmt_dt(start)}",
        f"DTEND;TZID={tz_name}:{fmt_dt(end)}" if tzinfo != datetime.timezone.utc else f"DTEND:{fmt_dt(end)}",
        f"SUMMARY:{TITLE}",
        "DESCRIPTION:Weekly team sync meeting",
        "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
        "SEQUENCE:0",
        "BEGIN:VALARM",
        "ACTION:DISPLAY",
        "DESCRIPTION:Team meeting starts in 15 minutes",
        "TRIGGER:-PT15M",
        "END:VALARM",
        "END:VEVENT",
        "END:VCALENDAR",
    ]
    ics_bytes = ("\r\n".join(fold_line(l) for l in lines) + "\r\n").encode()

with open(OUTPUT, "wb") as f:
    f.write(ics_bytes)

# --- Validate by re-parsing ---
from icalendar import Calendar as CalParser

with open(OUTPUT, "rb") as f:
    parsed = CalParser.from_ical(f.read())
vevents = [c for c in parsed.walk() if c.name == "VEVENT"]
assert len(vevents) == 1, "Expected exactly one VEVENT"
e = vevents[0]
assert e.get("summary") == TITLE
assert e.get("dtstart").dt == start
assert e.get("dtend").dt == end
assert e.get("uid") == uid

print(f"Created {OUTPUT}")
print(f"  Summary : {e.get('summary')}")
print(f"  Start   : {e.get('dtstart').dt} ({e.get('dtstart').dt.tzinfo})")
print(f"  End     : {e.get('dtend').dt}")
print(f"  Duration: {e.get('dtend').dt - e.get('dtstart').dt}")
print(f"  UID     : {uid}")
print("  Validation: OK (re-parsed successfully)")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Task-scoped helper: construct and validate a one-hour team meeting event
for next Wednesday at 3 PM, and emit the ICS content on stdout."""
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

# --- Determine next Wednesday (strictly after today, local time) ---
now = datetime.now().astimezone()
today = now.date()
tz = now.tzinfo

days_ahead = (2 - today.weekday()) % 7  # Wednesday == weekday 2
if days_ahead == 0:
    days_ahead = 7
next_wed = today + timedelta(days=days_ahead)

# --- Event window: 3:00 PM - 4:00 PM on that Wednesday ---
start = datetime(next_wed.year, next_wed.month, next_wed.day, 15, 0, tzinfo=tz)
end = datetime(next_wed.year, next_wed.month, next_wed.day, 16, 0, tzinfo=tz)

# --- Semantic validation ---
assert start.weekday() == 2, "event start must fall on a Wednesday"
assert start < end, "event end must be after event start"
assert end - start == timedelta(hours=1), "event must last exactly one hour"
assert (start.hour, start.minute) == (15, 0), "event must start at 3 PM"
assert (end.hour, end.minute) == (16, 0), "event must end at 4 PM"

# --- Serialize times with explicit timezone (TZID) or UTC fallback ---
tzid = getattr(tz, "key", None)
if tzid:
    dtstart = f"DTSTART;TZID={tzid}:{start:%Y%m%dT%H%M%S}"
    dtend = f"DTEND;TZID={tzid}:{end:%Y%m%dT%H%M%S}"
else:
    start_utc = start.astimezone(timezone.utc)
    end_utc = end.astimezone(timezone.utc)
    dtstart = f"DTSTART:{start_utc:%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ}"
    dtend = f"DTEND:{end_utc:%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ}"
    tzid = "UTC"

uid = f"team-meeting-{next_wed:%Y%m%d}@calendar-skill"
dtstamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")

ics = "\r\n".join([
    "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
    "VERSION:2.0",
    "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN",
    "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
    "METHOD:PUBLISH",
    "BEGIN:VEVENT",
    f"UID:{uid}",
    f"DTSTAMP:{dtstamp}",
    dtstart,
    dtend,
    "SUMMARY:Team Meeting",
    "DESCRIPTION:Team meeting on next Wednesday at 3 PM for one hour.",
    "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
    "TRANSP:OPAQUE",
    "SEQUENCE:0",
    "END:VEVENT",
    "END:VCALENDAR",
    "",
]).encode("utf-8")

# --- Structural validation ---
text = ics.decode("utf-8")
for required in ("BEGIN:VCALENDAR", "END:VCALENDAR", "BEGIN:VEVENT", "END:VEVENT",
                 "UID:", "DTSTAMP:", "DTSTART", "DTEND", "SUMMARY:Team Meeting"):
    assert required in text, f"ICS missing required component: {required}"

sys.stdout.buffer.write(ics)
sys.stderr.write(f"Constructed Team Meeting: {next_wed.isoformat()} 15:00-16:00 ({tzid})\n")
